name: Wraith of the Cards
storyline:
In the year 1920 - a lone sorceress named Crystal Piquet was called to a mysterious abandoned mansion. She was determined to improve her magical abilities and begins her journey to the cursed mansion....

Using her magical CARD BASED MAGIC, Crystal fights her way through monsters and ghouls to reach the top of the mansion, where she believes a secret that could help her become stronger lies in wait....

Are you up to the task to trek this cursed mansion...?
summary:
Wraith of the Cards is a turn-based deckbuilding RPG with platforming exploration! Explore the vast halls of a mysterious mansion that has called you forth, and attack your way through enemies using special card magic!

Explore the halls of the mansion in EXPLORE MODE, solving puzzles and clearing obstacles in your way. Search furnature to find Gears and other machanical tools to assist on your journey, but they aren't the only things hiding in the mansion...

Fight your way forward in BATTLE MODE, using a card-based battle system where magical cards are collected and harnessed for combat! Total higher numbers together to pack higher punches, and level up to unlock over 20 unique Special Cards!
